column1: # gauges.tsv --- THE GAUGES. Yours to edit; that is the point.
# Each row is a PAIR of counted ERE patterns and a ratio numerator/denominator. The tool counts,
# divides, and stops. It prints no verdict and no threshold, because a threshold picked-not-
# validated is the very fault these gauges exist to catch -- baking one in would ink my own guess
# into the instrument that measures guesses.
# Strike a row and a gauge disappears. Add one and it appears. Neither needs the tool's agreement.
# A denominator of 0 prints INF and is marked. That is not an error -- it is the loudest signal
# available: the document affords the reader nothing at all on that axis.
#   num         ERE counted for the numerator (grep -oE, case-insensitive)
#   den         ERE counted for the denominator
#   meaning     what a HIGH ratio means. Never what to do about it.
